name: Scheduled Cleanup Job
summary: A cron-triggered Postgres maintenance job: expire trials, abandoned carts, stale sessions, or any time-bounded record, with an advisory lock and a run log so overlapping runs are safe and auditable.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret appended to the trigger path as ?secret=. Neon does not sign trigger delivery, so this authenticates the cron POST rather than merely recognising it.

env.name: CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE
env.description: Maximum records expired per run. Bounds per-invocation cost; the next run picks up the remainder.

env.name: CLEANUP_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Time-to-live applied by POST /register when a record is added without an explicit expiry.

triggers.description: Expire records whose deadline has passed and record the run. Every five minutes bounds how long a record lingers past its expiry.

operations.title: POST /run
operations.description: cron, every 5 minutes — expire due records under an advisory lock, then log the run

operations.title: GET /preview
operations.description: HTTP — dry run: how many records would expire right now, by kind

operations.title: POST /register
operations.description: HTTP — register a record to expire (demo/producer side of the job)
